_draft: A2.4 seed for GLONASS. celestrak.org was UNREACHABLE (connection timed out) from the build env — same as A2.1's ECONNREFUSED — so the CelesTrak GLONASS-RE SupGP pair is NOT captured. See README.md. Unlike GPS, the IAC SP3 IS a real state-vector ephemeris, so the hard-RMS gate IS achievable — but only after the OD-side prerequisites below are met (frame + time system).
name: GLONASS (IAC precise SP3) — CelesTrak parity
gatePrerequisites: OD frame transform IGS20/ITRF2020 (ECEF) -> TEME. A2.2a implemented EME2000/J2000/GCRF -> TEME (inertial precession+nutation) only; IAC SP3 is an EARTH-FIXED (ITRF) frame, whose transform to TEME needs Earth-rotation-angle + polar motion + UT1, NOT yet in the OD module. Until added, A2.2a fail-closes on this frame.
OD time system GPS -> UTC. A2.2a is UTC-only (fail-closed otherwise); IAC SP3 declares TIME_SYSTEM=GPS, so a GPS->UTC (leap-second) step is required before the OD fit.
Position-only OD fit. IAC SP3 has no velocity records (STATE_VECTOR_SIZE=3); confirm the OD SGP4 fit accepts a position-only state series.
missionAssumptionCorrection: Packet said PZ-90.11 ECEF; the real IAC precise SP3 declares IGS20 (ITRF2020 realization) / GPS time. PZ-90.11 is the GLONASS BROADCAST-nav frame, a different product.
slotToNoradCrossReference: TODO-A2.4-obtain-authoritative-GLONASS-slot-to-NORAD mapping (SP3 carries only the Rnn slot id)

tolerances.note: Achievable once gatePrerequisites are met (frame + time + position-only OD).
